skills.description: 轻量级 WebApp 多智能体协作框架，单个技能文件即包含完整的 7 Agent 角色定义、11 状态机流转规则、 团队创建与分派逻辑。适用于快速搭建多 Agent 协作项目，无需依赖其他文件。 触发词：mini-harness、轻量框架、快速搭建、初始化协作、建团队、build-team、多 agent 协作。
skills.description_zh:
>#Mini-Harness 使用说明
##是什么
Mini-Harness 是一个轻量级多智能体协作框架，一个 SKILL.md 文件就包含完整的 7 Agent 角色 + 11 状态工作流 + 分派规则。装上就能在任何 WorkBuddy 项目里用，不依赖其他文件。

##使用方法
安装后在 CodeBuddy/Workbuddy 对话中输入触发词即可：
/mini-harness

##框架核心

###7 个 Agent 角色
PM / Planner / Coder / Reviewer / Tester / Evaluator / Deployer

###11 状态工作流
IDEA → PLAN → TEST-PLAN → CODE → REVIEW → DEPLOY-TEST → TEST-RUN → EVAL → DEPLOY-PROD → MONITOR → ARCHIVE

###TDD 驱动
Coder 按 RED→GREEN→REFACTOR 循环，测试覆盖率≥80%

###6 维 Review
正确性 / 可读性 / 可测性 / 性能 / 安全 / 风格，任一 BLOCK 则回退

##质量门禁
EVAL 评分 ≥80 PASS / 60-79 WARN / <60 BLOCK

##关键约束
Review 不可跳过：CODE 之后必须经过 REVIEW
默认测试环境：deploy 命令默认部署到测试环境，--prod 需 PM 审批
E2E 禁止 mock 后端：TEST-RUN 阶段必须用真实后端
Team Lead 只分派不执行：主 Agent 不写代码、不跑测试、不亲自部署
团队就绪后等用户：7 个 Agent 创建完成后必须停下来，等用户输入需求
##适用场景
快速搭建多 Agent 协作开发项目
需要 TDD + Review + 自动部署的标准化流程
skills.name: mini-harness

skills.description: Through fixed cameras (and optional microphones) in dementia care facilities or homes, the system analyzes behaviors of people with dementia to identify confusion/disorientation states: sudden activity stops (interrupting ongoing actions such as eating or walking for ≥ 5 seconds), gaze drifting (eyes wandering without focus), looking around (frequent head turning), and repeated disorientation questions ('Where is this?', 'What time is it?', 'Who are you?' — requires voice recognition / voiceprint binding). When such behaviors are detected, oriented soothing is automatically triggered: smart speakers play family member introductions (e.g. 'Your son is Li Ming, he will visit you at noon'), current time and location reminders ('Today is May 19 2026, Thursday, you are at Happiness Home Nursing Center'), with a gentle tone. This skill helps reduce anxiety and confusion in people with dementia and improve quality of life. Application scenarios: dementia care facilities, cognitive care units, home care. The system monitors in real time and proactively provides orientation cues when confusion occurs. Skill features: people with dementia often feel lost, anxious, and develop behavioral issues (wandering, agitation) due to memory loss. AI-based real-time confusion recognition with orientation soothing can reduce distress, slow cognitive decline, and ease caregiver burden.
